pages.text: When the tide went out, pools formed between the rocks. Riri and Lolo climbed onto the rocks.
They wanted to see the octopus hiding in the cracks. "Octopuses are champions at hiding. We will find it!"
Riri brought her face close to a pool. Lolo splashed a foot in. "Watch quietly, and it will come out." "Startle it, and it will come out."
Riri studied the first pool for a long time. Only one shrimp bounced about.
Riri examined the second pool too. Only her own round face was reflected in it.
Lolo splashed and stirred the pool. A black cloud spread from between the rocks.
Ink! Lolo's face turned completely black.
A gust blew Riri's hat away. It floated on the pool.
One arm slipped out from between the rocks. The octopus put the hat on its head.
Wearing the hat, the octopus went around the pool once. Riri and Lolo watched, hardly breathing. It took off the hat and slipped back into the rocks.
